I went today and the store was a mess. I asked an employee if the product was expired because my eyesight isn't great, and he laughed. That's the level of service. It's not the first time they've sold me NATH brand products that are nearing their expiration date or are already expired.

Bad experience #2: I've been waiting for six days for an order I placed on the app to arrive. The customer service call center is clueless. I went to the Conde de Salvatierra store in Valencia three times, and the employees complained, but they were clueless too. The worst part is that when you complain, they take it personally; they don't know how to handle complex situations. The employee told me that if I was having problems saving the discount from the website, I should just go to the store to avoid the bad experiences... a pathetic response.

Meanwhile, I can't buy anything in the store either because they don't have the product in stock, and my cat is without his food. I've already indicated that this is my second bad experience, but every month it's a different story with the order. Bad service, even worse customer service.

Bad experience #1: I regularly buy Nath cat food and pâté for my cat and pick it up at the store. Every time I've gone, the employees have been so unfriendly that you just want to leave as soon as possible. Yesterday, December 10th, I went to pick up my order and all three employees were at the counter in the afternoon, each doing different things, and none of them seemed willing to help me with what I needed. They spoke to me as if I worked at Kiwoko and knew exactly what to do in any given situation.

Especially the girl with long black hair; she was very rude. Someone who tells a customer "TELL ME" without explaining what they need to know either needs better training or shouldn't be working in customer service because she's so rude.

I hope this improves because the brand I buy is exclusive to Kiwoko, and I'll continue going to the store, or I'll have to switch brands.

They're selling a product they don't have, as if it were another. Specifically, the Schesir cat food pouches. This product appears on the website, I bought it online, and when I went to pick it up at the Conde Salvatierra store in Valencia, I saw that it was a different product, a different type, a complete food. They told me that's all they had, that the previous one was discontinued, and that this was the one they were selling, that they'd only changed the packaging. And that's not true; the ingredients are different, it's not the same product, and they're offering it for sale even though it's discontinued.
The saleswoman's customer service was terrible, with a bad attitude, telling me it was a website issue, as if it weren't the same company. She didn't apologize at all.
I suggest that the company, in addition to reviewing the attitude of its staff, remove products they don't have from online sales to avoid creating this kind of confusion.

And she offers me a garbage bag and I'm just stunned.

The sales assistant was very friendly and helpful, but the store was a disaster. Prices didn't match the products, everything was disorganized, dirty, and they were missing a lot of items.

This store is in the center of Valencia, near Colón Street.

P.S. I have my receipt and everything; this experience is real.
